plan_review.notes: Reviewer rejected shared raw files across independent TS/MJS caches. Adopted sidecar-authoritative cache backed by an industry-standard cross-process content-addressable store plus serialized global LRU maintenance; extensions become thin proxies and no longer own disk caches. Added non-secret account/container namespace hashing, mutable-vs-immutable snapshot semantics, write/invalidation commit ordering, first-class cached brief/slice/list responses, and zero-Azure-read plus namespace/concurrency tests. Alt A sidecar-authoritative selected; Alt B shared SQLite library rejected because Node 22 sqlite is experimental and native dependency cost is high; Alt C split caches folded into typed entries within one authoritative cache.
